audit.why: The already-audited mirror settled this matchup as Ziggs owning levels 1-2 only, with Level 3, Level 6 and 2+ items going to Garen. The label also read 'Even matchup' while diff already said HARD.

audit.whatIsWrong: Packet flagged zero cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere in the matchup.
audit.why: Decisive Strike is a flat 8s at 300 range, Courage 22/19.5/17/14.5/12s, Judgment 9s down to 6s at 325, Demacian Justice 120/100/80s at 400. Your Satchel Charge is 20s at rank 1 and Hexplosive Minefield a flat 16s.
audit.corrected: Concrete 'step up on its downtime' lines built around the flat 8s Q and the 22s Courage are written into early and mid.

audit.whatIsWrong: Text told you to wall Hexplosive Minefield to slow his engage, and never mentioned that Demacian Justice is true damage or that Decisive Strike is an auto-attack reset.
audit.why: Decisive Strike gives a burst of move speed and breaks free of all slows affecting him, so the minefield slow is purged and he walks through the mines rather than around them — the advice inverted the actual interaction. Demacian Justice deals true damage on an execute, so MR is the wrong lever. And Decisive Strike is an auto-attack reset: the wind-up, not the cast, is the tell.
audit.corrected: The minefield is reframed as a tax rather than a wall, the true-damage execute is stated, and the auto-reset tell is added to spikes[0].text.
